entities.summary: Ayub Bachchu was a Bangladeshi rock guitarist, composer, singer and songwriter, who was the founder of the Bangladeshi rock band Love Runs Blind and earned success as the lead singer and the lead guitarist of the band. He is considered a pop culture icon in Bangladesh. He was one of the pioneers of Bangladeshi pop music.
